description: This file defines types and a class for caching sent messages, including functions for normalization and TTL-based cache management, used for matching inbound messages to recently sent outbound messages in an iMessage monitoring context.

classes.name: DefaultSentMessageCache
classes.description: Implements the SentMessageCache interface, managing message caches with TTL-based cleanup.

methods.name: normalizeEchoTextKey
methods.description: Normalizes message text by replacing line endings and trimming whitespace.

methods.name: normalizeEchoMessageIdKey
methods.description: Normalizes message ID by trimming and filtering out specific values.

methods.name: createSentMessageCache
methods.description: Factory function to create a new instance of DefaultSentMessageCache.
